intro.text: Lopen's Herdazian mother, a forceful woman who loves to cook and feed people, living in Little Herdaz in Highprince Sebarial's warcamp.

items.text: When a wounded King Elhokar was recovering in Little Herdaz, she made him eat despite his objections, saying he looked pale and she didn't want him found underfed.

personality.text: She speaks Alethi with a thick accent, runs her household firmly and keeps axehounds.

Lopen calls her wise: she encouraged his jokes about his missing arm, telling him to laugh before others could. Her word carries weight with her relatives; his cousin Punio joined Bridge Four after hearing her say they needed help.
